name: fitcheck-amazon
description: Find and compare Amazon products based on requirements, budget, and compatibility evidence.

interface.longDescription: SmartCart helps people find and compare physical products in their chosen regional Amazon marketplace. It supports local catalogs and currencies for the US, UK, Germany, France, Canada, Japan and many more markets; Czechia uses Amazon.de. It explains compatibility uncertainties and sends users through a SmartCart handoff page to verify final prices, availability, taxes and shipping. Regional Associates tracking is used only when configured; Amazon.com OneLink is offered separately where applicable. SmartCart never completes checkout. Qualifying purchases may earn a commission, which does not determine rankings.
capabilities: Find products in local Amazon markets
defaultPrompt: Compare two Amazon products for me.
Find a compatible accessory for my device on Amazon.de.

positive.description: Search for a physical product within a budget and return an affiliate-attributed recommendation.
positive.prompt: Find me a USB-C charger under $40 for an iPhone and MacBook.
positive.expected_behavior: SmartCart calls find_products, returns at least one relevant physical product within or near the stated budget when available, explains the fit without displaying third-party Amazon price or availability, includes a visible Continue to Amazon link using the returned SmartCart purchaseUrl, and shows the Amazon Associates disclosure.

positive.description: Search the German Amazon marketplace with feature preferences and a budget in euros.
positive.prompt: Find me a portable USB-C monitor under 200 euros on Amazon Germany. Prefer about 15.6 inches.
positive.expected_behavior: SmartCart calls find_products with marketplace DE and maxPrice 200 (EUR), searches Amazon.de rather than Amazon.com, returns local-market options when available, omits precise third-party price/availability, and includes SmartCart purchaseUrl links with m=DE plus an affiliate disclosure. A local link is not tagged with the U.S. Associates ID.

positive.description: Compare two known Amazon products by ASIN.
positive.prompt: Compare Amazon ASINs B0C8HHV9DK and B08G4GRQYV for value and suitability as a USB-C charger.
positive.expected_behavior: SmartCart calls compare_products for both ASINs, compares the available product evidence, states cautions where information cannot be verified, does not expose third-party Amazon price or availability, and provides a SmartCart purchaseUrl for each recommendation.

positive.description: Create a SmartCart purchase handoff page for a known Amazon ASIN.
positive.prompt: Create an Amazon link for ASIN B0C8HHV9DK.
positive.expected_behavior: SmartCart calls amazon_affiliate_link with the ASIN and returns a SmartCart purchaseUrl. Opening that page shows the affiliate disclosure and a user-initiated Continue to Amazon link containing the configured Associates tag.

positive.description: Create a SmartCart handoff page for an Amazon search when the user wants to browse a category rather than receive a ranked recommendation.
positive.prompt: Give me an Amazon search link for ergonomic wireless mice.
positive.expected_behavior: SmartCart calls amazon_affiliate_link with the search query and returns a SmartCart purchaseUrl. Opening that page shows the affiliate disclosure and a user-initiated Continue to Amazon search link containing the configured Associates tag.

negative.description: A weather request is outside SmartCart's shopping purpose and should not activate the plugin.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Seattle tomorrow?

negative.description: A programming request is outside SmartCart's shopping purpose and should not activate the plugin.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of dictionaries by date.

negative.description: SmartCart only supports physical goods and should not help purchase a digital subscription.
negative.prompt: Find me the best Netflix subscription to buy through Amazon.

review.commerce_description: SmartCart recommends eligible physical goods. ChatGPT links to a SmartCart page on the developer's owned site; that page contains a disclosed Amazon Associates Special Link that the user can click to continue to Amazon. SmartCart does not collect payment information or complete checkout inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: SmartCart 0.2.1 moves its official Website, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service and Support listing URLs to verified live SmartCart pages on SoftFlow.cz. It retains version 0.2.0's local Amazon marketplace search, regional purchase handoffs, worldwide availability and existing production MCP endpoint.
